checks.meta_program_cell_lines: meta_program_sources.tsv counts each program's cell-line studies (Kinker et al. 2020's CCLE pools and other cell-line sets). Kinker's pools hold the cells of validation and test lines, the exposure ruled out for Kinker's own programs on 2026-10-04, so a config reads only programs with no cell-line study (21 of 41; decided 2026-10-12).
checks.tirosh_cell_cycle: Tirosh et al. 2016 (Science 352:189, PMC4944528): 'we used gene signatures previously shown to denote G1/S or G2/M phases in both synchronization and single-cell experiments in cell lines', citing Whitfield et al. 2002 (synchronised HeLa; HeLa is a test line here) and Macosko et al. 2015. Canonical cell-cycle genes from an earlier experiment, no deposit this project reads; kept and noted.
